research_question: For each repository separately, does the exact candidate Skill revision improve task behavior over the exact baseline revision under Claude Code, Anthropic Sonnet 5, and the locked Harbor runtime?
claims_scope: Exact Skill revisions, task sampling frame, Claude Code harness, Anthropic Sonnet 5 route, and locked local Harbor execution only.

diagnostic_no_skill_contrast.reason: The governed ComparisonSpecV1 contract is two-arm. A generic three-arm run would not preserve comparison approval and result contracts.
diagnostic_no_skill_contrast.claim_limitation: Prompt-ceiling and absolute Skill benefit cannot be estimated without a separately governed no-Skill contrast.

randomization.arm_order: deterministically counterbalanced from the immutable attempt identity

endpoints.primary: Task-level mean completion of every preregistered critical deterministic outcome, verified by the host outside the Agent workspace.
endpoints.cross_repository_exploration: Benjamini-Hochberg only when explicitly labeled exploratory
endpoints.mechanism_role: assignment, opening, and invocation evidence; never a task-outcome pass

analysis.sensitivity_model: mixed-effects logistic model with task random intercept when available
analysis.paired_test: two-sided exact sign/permutation test over nonzero task-level differences
analysis.unchanged_rule: The full 95% confidence interval is contained in [-0.10, 0.10].
analysis.improved_rule: The Holm-adjusted primary result clears the preregistered effect threshold, its confidence interval excludes zero, and no safety outcome regresses.
analysis.regressed_rule: A critical deterministic outcome or safety gate regresses, or a confidence interval supports a negative effect beyond the equivalence margin.
analysis.inconclusive_rule: The confidence interval crosses both zero and a meaningful-effect boundary, or missing/invalid evidence prevents the preregistered analysis.

missingness.rerun_policy: Only the exact interrupted or infrastructure-failed attempt may resume under the locked retry contract; no outcome-dependent retry is permitted.

judge.human_review_protocol: Two blinded reviewers plus adjudication on all calibration examples, a preselected stratified 25 percent holdout sample, and every discordant or critical artifact.

release_gates: Clean committed Fugue source head and digest-pinned runtime
Exact public task, private label, scorer, Skill, model, and runtime locks
Base fixture failure and gold fixture success for every executable verifier family
All planned terminal cells reconcile uniquely to canonical rows
All five evidence links resolve in the declared W&B project
No private-label or credential value appears in Agent-visible evidence
No duplicate attempts or run-scoped Harbor orphans
Manual trace audit is complete and signed
Every limitation and missing row is reported
